asset.description: The tracked plant/asset disposed of, when it resolves to the asset spine.

disposal_method.description: How the item left service (sold / scrapped / written off / returned).

disposed_at.description: The date of disposal as recorded on the form, where it differs from submission time.

disposed_item_description.description: What was disposed of, as named on the disposal record; the free-text fallback that carries the fact when no asset resolves.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source disposal record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

financial_period.description: The accounting period the disposal falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

form_id.description: Source form template identity; meaningful only on form-backed sources.

form_title.description: The tenant template title the disposal was captured on.

jurisdiction.description: The WHS/environmental regime whose duty and retention rule apply.

occurred_at.description: When the disposal was recorded/submitted; the life-cycle retirement event time and the retention clock.

proceeds_amount.description: Sale proceeds, where the disposal was a sale.

quantity.description: Number of items disposed, when more than one.

worker.description: The worker who processed or submitted the disposal; the accountable identity.
